measured_on.changes_made_to_the_phone: none; the user selected Panorama in the camera and the log was read afterwards

symptom: the Xiaomi camera's extra modes cannot be downloaded; every Qigsaw module directory is empty
finding: the download and unpack succeed and the failure is the first dlopen of a split's native library, after which Qigsaw deletes the module

modules_declared.note: no assets/qigsaw/ split payload exists in the base APK, so every module is fetched at runtime

download_verified.conclusion: the CDN, DNS and the phone's network are not involved in the failure

failure.linker: dlopen failed: couldn't map "/data/data/com.android.camera/app_qigsaw/5.0.0.0/panorama/8.4.1@17/nativeLib/arm64-v8a/libmorpho_sensor_fusion.so" segment 2: Permission denied
failure.rollback: MCAM_Split.FileUtil deleted panorama.apk, the nativeLib tree, the oat tree and the version directory
failure.avc_note: the platform policy dontaudits app data execute, so the linker message is the only record

policy_measurement.priv_app_note: priv_app may execute privapp_data_file, but a platform-key-signed app is matched to platform_app with app_data_file by seapp_contexts, so that path does not apply
policy_measurement.decode_rule: bit value for a permission is 1 << (index - 1); granted iff allowed_mask & bit

stock_reference.observation: the retained /data still carries a package-manager record of /data/user/0/com.android.camera/app_qigsaw/5.0.0.0/panorama/8.4.1@17/panorama.apk marked (removed)
stock_reference.reading: the module was installed under the stock ROM before this one was flashed, so stock permits the load

text_relocation_survey.conclusion: execmod is not required; execute alone is enough to map them

cost.scope: every platform-key-signed app may run native code it wrote into its own data directory

not_established: That any mode installs and runs. That is a device result for the delivery set that carries the rule
Whether a module needs a permission beyond execute once its libraries load
The six modules other than panorama were never observed downloading
